title: Week 1: how the cohort works
summary: Day one of our 10-week Decoding Bitcoin cohort. How the weeks work, how to earn the certificate, a tour of your personal dashboard, a live quiz where one changed letter scrambled half a hash, and Razor on what the BOSS Challenge is really like.
share_text: Week 1 of Decoding Bitcoin: 10 Mondays, one question each, a hash that changes half its bits when you change one letter, and what comes after. Notes (and 4 mini-games) from @CodeOrangeDevs

todo.title: Before next Monday
items: Save your personal dashboard link somewhere safe. There is no login: the link is your key. Open my dashboard
Watch Discord and your email for your assigned discussion question, then prepare to explain it in your own words.
Read the week 1 lessons on Decoding Bitcoin: Welcome, Bitcoin History and UTXO vs Account Models.
Try the exercises: say hi in the cohort channel, play with the Hash Functions tool, and pick apart one transaction on mempool.space.
Do the weekly check: five questions, two minutes.
DM one classmate on Discord. Find your study buddy.

tldr: Decoding Bitcoin is 10 Mondays, 90 minutes each, cameras off for privacy. Transactions first, then script and multisig, your own project, Taproot, and a graduation.

The certificate is for showing up and doing the work: attend, do the exercises (they count, the slide saying optional was a mistake) and the weekly check. Can't make it live? Post your homework on Discord and it still counts.
Everyone gets one discussion question for next Monday, by Discord tag and email. You explain it to the group, because the teacher learns the most.
Decoding Bitcoin by The Bitcoin Dev Project is the source of truth for lessons and exercises. Your dashboard is a personal link with no login, so save it.

ideas: Also mentioned: the last cohort we ran, rawBit, had 20 sign-ups and 2 finishers, so do not worry about keeping up with everyone. Just keep showing up. A Code Orange meetup next year came up as an idea, and the dashboard first used a Nostr login before switching to a personal link to cut friction.

quiz.q: You can't make it to the live call on Monday. Can you still earn the certificate?
o: No, attendance is the only thing that counts
Yes, if you do the work and post your homework on Discord
Only if you watch the recording twice
quiz.w: Asked on the call, answered yes: do the lessons and exercises on your own, post them on Discord and ask questions there.

quiz.q: You hash a word with SHA-256, then change one letter and hash it again. How much of the output changes?
o: Only the last character or two
quiz.w: The avalanche effect. One tiny change flips roughly half the bits, so a hash tells you nothing about how close two inputs are.

quiz.q: How do you log in to your Decoding Bitcoin dashboard?
o: With your email and a password
You don't: you open your personal link, so save it
quiz.w: No accounts, no passwords. A Nostr login was tried first but added friction, so your dashboard link is your key.
